title: Rollback: Experience Backtracking in World Models for Policy Improvement
abstract: arXiv:2610.36068v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Action-conditioned world models offer a scalable alternative to costly real-world interaction for improving robot policies. However, existing world-model-based methods largely treat world models as forward-only surrogates of the physical environment, leaving untapped a capability no physical environment affords: rewinding to past decision points to explore counterfactual futures. We introduce Rollback, a policy improvement paradigm that turns world models from passive simulators into counterfactual engines: it rolls back to critical decision points, branches into alternative actions, and contrasts their outcomes to attribute success to individual decisions. This concentrates imagination where it matters most and distills counterfactual outcomes into fine-grained, action-level supervision without a separately learned value model. We build a scalable training system that unifies distributed world-model search with asynchronous real-robot

translated_title: Rollback：世界模型中面向策略改进的经验回溯
translated_abstract: 动作条件化的世界模型为改进机器人策略提供了一种可扩展的替代方案，避免依赖昂贵的高真实世界交互。然而，现有的基于世界模型的方法大多将世界模型仅视为物理环境的前向代理，未能利用一项任何物理环境都无法提供的能力：回溯到过去的决策点以探索反事实的未来。我们提出了Rollback，这是一种策略改进范式，它将世界模型从被动模拟器转变为反事实引擎：该方法回溯到关键决策点，分支出替代动作，并对比不同动作的结果，从而将成功归因于单个决策。这使得“想象”集中在最关键之处，并将反事实结果提炼为细粒度的、动作级别的监督信号，而无需单独训练的价值模型。我们构建了一个可扩展的训练系统，将分布式世界模型搜索与异步真机机器人（数据收集）统一起来。
tldr: 提出Rollback策略改进范式，利用世界模型回溯关键决策点并分支探索反事实动作，将反事实结果转化为细粒度的动作级监督信号，无需单独的价值模型即可改进机器人策略。
en_tdlr: Rollback is a policy improvement paradigm that rewinds world models to critical decision points, branches into counterfactual actions, and distills their contrasting outcomes into fine-grained action-level supervision for improving robot policies without a separately learned value model.
